annotation.evidence_span: for a period of time determined by the authentication scheme, parameters, and/or user preferences
annotation.interpretation_a: The period starts at the time of the prior authorized request and applies to all subsequent requests within that protection space.
annotation.interpretation_b: The period starts at the time of each subsequent request, allowing the same credentials to be reused for a period after each request.
annotation.justification: The lack of a defined start time for the period of reuse creates a concrete missing constraint that can result in materially different implementation behaviours.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify when the period of time begins, leading to different possible implementation behaviours regarding credential reuse timing. This missing constraint makes the clause ambiguous.
